thread:
Hannah (Support): customer reports that their org dashboard shows a 50 credit trial applied, but API usage shows no credits being consumed. customer says they see normal 200 responses from the API but balance remains unchanged. :confused:
Devon (Eng): can you paste a minimal repro (curl) and the exact service key they used? especially the response headers we set (x-project-id / x-billing-project)
Hannah (Support): here's the example from the customer (redacted key):
```\ncurl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-deadbeef\" \\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\n  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hi"}'\n```
Response body: {"id":"gen_abc","output":"hello"} (200)
Response headers they copied: x-request-id: rq_01, x-project-id: old-proj-123, x-rate-limit: 120
Hannah (Support): customer attached screenshot of Console showing org `acme-co` has 50 trial credits (applied 2026-01-10) but their service key (above) is still billed to `old-proj-123` per header.
Devon (Eng): that header is telling — the runtime is attributing the request to old-proj-123. can you run the admin tool to fetch the service key mapping? e.g. `adminctl servicekey get sk-prod-deadbeef`
Hannah (Support): ran with them (they allowed). adminctl output: 
```\nservice_key: sk-prod-deadbeef\nowner_org: acme-co\nproject_id: old-proj-123\ncreated_at: 2025-06-02\n```
Hannah (Support): customer expected project_id to be `acme-co-main` where the trial credits are applied. they believe a migration last month may have changed project ids. :eyes: 
Ben (ProdOps): we ran the org migration in June that created new canonical project ids and added aliases. most service keys were auto-mapped but looks like this particular key retained the legacy project_id.
Carol (Billing): because usage was attributed to old-proj-123 (which has no trial credits), billing engine didn't decrement the acme-co trial balance. we'll need to remap historical usage or issue a credit. can support get written approval from the customer for a usage resync?
Hannah (Support): customer ok with resync and refund if possible. asks for steps and ETA.
Devon (Eng): root cause: service key metadata project_id points to legacy project. two remediation paths:
1) Rotate service key: create a new service key scoped to `acme-co-main` and have customer swap it in. that fixes future usage immediately and preserves audit trail.
2) Backfill: ProdOps/Billing can re-assign historical usage from old-proj-123 -> acme-co-main and trigger a credits resync. this requires manual approval and might take 24-48h.
Ben (ProdOps): I can update the mapping for the service key to point at acme-co-main, but we prefer rotation to avoid changing key metadata in-place. if customer requests backfill we'll need the ticket + approval.
Carol (Billing): if they want the backfill, we need: customer org id, service key fingerprint, date range (from migration date to now). we'll then run a resync job and apply a one-time credit equal to the usage that should have been covered by the trial. ETA 1-2 business days after approvals.
Hannah (Support): provided the customer the two options. they want quick fix (rotate key) and also asked for the backfill for prior calls during the trial window. they agreed to sign the approval for backfill.
BillingBot: automated note: created billing-resync job br_20260215 for org acme-co, service_key sk-prod-deadbeef, range 2025-06-01..2026-02-15. status: pending approval.
Devon (Eng): for audit please also capture a small repro we can run internally so we can add a test to the migration checklist. minimal curl + adminctl output is enough.
Hannah (Support): internal repro saved in zendesk ticket 67312. next steps: 1) ask customer to rotate to new key (instructions + sample curl) 2) collect signed approval email for backfill 3) ProdOps to either remap or run backfill once approved 4) Billing to apply credit if needed.
Carol (Billing): noted. I'll queue the resync after approval and respond back here when complete.
Ben (ProdOps): temporary mitigation for other customers: running a check to list service keys whose project_id != current canonical project id and flag them for rotation. I'll push a short runbook.
Hannah (Support): thanks all. I'll update the customer: rotate key now to get credits applied going forward; we'll process a backfill after approval. :thumbsup:
Devon (Eng): leaving a follow-up action for eng: add a post-migration verification that verifies servicekey.project_id matches alias mapping. filing in eng backlog under INF-1427.
Hannah (Support): closing loop with the customer and attaching the approval — will update thread when Billing confirms the resync is complete.
